description: Erection of a front and rear roof extension; erection of a rear extension at second floor level over part of the existing back addition; erection of a single storey rear extension to the side and rear of the existing back addition, in part to replace an existing single storey element; infilling of 1no window and replacement of 2no existing windows with new windows at first floor level to the rear elevation.
decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall not commence later than the expiration of 3 years beginning with the date of this planning permission.

Condition required to be imposed by section 91(1)(a) of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended by section 51 of the Planning and Compulsory Purchase Act 2004).
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in complete accordance with the following approved drawing numbers, other than where those details are altered pursuant to the conditions of this planning permission:

A-(13)-011 (received 27.07.26);
A-(13)-012 (received 27.07.26);
A-(14)-010 (received 27.07.26);
A-(15)-010 (received 27.07.26);
A-(15)-011 (received 27.07.26);
Flood Risk Assessment (ref. AEG11070_SW6_LBHF_01).

To ensure full compliance with the planning application hereby approved and to prevent harm arising through deviations from the approved plans.
Condition : 3 - The development hereby approved shall be carried out and completed in accordance with the materials details (including colour and finish) specified below:

- Walls: Brick to match the existing building in terms of brick and mortar colour and bond pattern.

- Roof extensions: Slate or slate appearance tiles to match the existing.

- Windows: Timber framed, painted white, style, detail and finish to match the existing.

- Doors to ground floor extension: Anthracite or black aluminium.

The development shall be permanently retained in accordance with the approved details. 

Any works of making good to existing elevations shall be carried out in materials to match the elevation to which the works relate.

To ensure a satisfactory external appearance, in accordance with Policies DC1, DC4 and DC8 of the Local Plan (2018).
Condition : 4 - No part of any roof of the extensions hereby approved or the remainder of the roof of the outrigger shall be used as a roof terrace or other form of open amenity space. No alterations shall be carried out; nor planters or other chattels placed on the roofs. No railings or other means of enclosure shall be erected on the roofs, and no alterations shall be carried out to the property to form access onto these roofs.

Such a use would be detrimental to the amenities of neighbouring properties by reason of overlooking and loss of privacy and potential noise and disturbance, contrary to Policies CC11 and HO11 of the Local Plan (2018).
Condition : 5 - No water tanks, water tank enclosures or other structures (excluding solar panels and air source heat pumps) shall be erected upon the roofs of the extensions hereby permitted.  

It is considered that such structures would seriously detract from the appearance of the building, contrary to Policies DC4 and DC8 of the Local Plan (2018).
Condition : 6 - The development shall be carried out and completed in full accordance with the details contained within the approved Flood Risk Assessment (ref. AEG11070_SW6_LBHF_01). No part of the development shall be used or occupied until all flood prevention and mitigation, SuDS and water efficiency measures have been installed in accordance with the submitted details and the development shall be permanently retained in this form and maintained as necessary thereafter. 

To limit the impact on flood risk and mitigate the susceptibility of the development to flooding in accordance with Policies CC2, CC3 and CC4 of the Local Plan (2018).
